description.en: Pipe supports for copper and PEX runs: a C-shaped snap clip that clicks onto the pipe, a saddle standoff that holds the pipe off the wall on a screw post, and a two-ear band clamp that fully surrounds the pipe. Bores are sized to real copper and PEX outside diameters (1/2" = 15.875 mm, 3/4" = 22.225 mm, 1" = 28.575 mm) so the grip matches the pipe you have.
description.es: Soportes de tuberia para lineas de cobre y PEX: un clip de presion en C que se encaja en la tuberia, un separador de silla que sostiene la tuberia lejos de la pared sobre un poste con tornillos y una abrazadera de banda de dos orejas que rodea por completo la tuberia. Los barrenos se dimensionan a diametros exteriores reales de cobre y PEX (1/2" = 15.875 mm, 3/4" = 22.225 mm, 1" = 28.575 mm) para que el agarre coincida con tu tuberia.

description.en: A C-shaped snap clip on a flat screw base. The mouth is opened narrower than the pipe diameter so the pipe clicks in and is retained.
A half-round saddle cradle raised on a screw post so the pipe stands off the wall by an adjustable distance, for clearance and to reduce sweating contact.

label.es: Abrazadera de Banda de Dos Orejas

description.en: A full ring that surrounds the pipe with a screw ear on each side, for a firm anchored clamp where a snap clip is not enough.

tooltip.en: Radial gap added over the pipe OD. Smaller for a firm grip, larger for insulated or out-of-round pipe.
tooltip.es: Espacio radial anadido sobre el OD de la tuberia. Menor para agarre firme, mayor para tuberia aislada o fuera de redondez.

label.es: Apertura de la Boca de Presion (fraccion del OD)

tooltip.en: How wide the snap mouth is relative to the pipe diameter. Below 1.0 the pipe must click past the jaw and is retained; lower values grip harder. Only affects the C-snap clip.
tooltip.es: Que tan ancha es la boca respecto al diametro de la tuberia. Por debajo de 1.0 la tuberia debe pasar a presion y queda retenida; valores menores agarran mas fuerte. Solo afecta el clip en C.

tooltip.en: Clip wall around the pipe bore. 2.5-3.5 mm balances spring and strength for a snap clip.
tooltip.es: Pared del clip alrededor del barreno. 2.5-3.5 mm equilibra resorte y resistencia para un clip de presion.

label.es: Largo del Clip a lo Largo de la Tuberia (mm)

tooltip.en: How much of the pipe the clip wraps along its length. Longer clips hold more firmly.
tooltip.es: Cuanto abarca el clip a lo largo de la tuberia. Clips mas largos sujetan mas firmemente.

tooltip.en: How far the saddle standoff holds the pipe off the wall. Only affects the saddle standoff.
tooltip.es: Que tan lejos sostiene el separador la tuberia de la pared. Solo afecta el separador de silla.

societal_benefit.en: Lets anyone support and route copper or PEX runs cleanly with printed clips sized to their exact pipe, instead of buying bags of one-size hardware, and standardizes the saddle bore on real tube ODs shared across the plumbing commons.
societal_benefit.es: Permite sostener y guiar lineas de cobre o PEX de forma limpia con clips impresos a la medida exacta de su tuberia, en lugar de comprar bolsas de herrajes de talla unica, y estandariza el barreno de la silla en ODs de tubo reales compartidos en el procomun de plomeria.
